Mon: 10:00-11:00, 11:30-13:00, 14:00-15:00, 15:30-17:00
My summary: Mon: 10:00-13:00, 14:00-17:00.  There are gaps at 11:00-11:30, 13:00-14:00 and 15:00-15:30 that I included as busy. This was a mistake.

Let me re-create the busy blocks accurately.
Priya's busy times:
Mon: 10:00-13:00 (this is a block) but there is a gap 11-11:30 is Travel, not a free slot. Let me re-read the calendar more carefully. The items are listed per 30 minutes slot.<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Brad says there are no free slots. I need to re-verify my work. It's possible I made a mistake when summarizing the busy times for Priya and Marcus. I will meticulously check their calendars again and identify their exact free slots.

Now, I will find the common free slots for Priya and Marcus.
